title: Money Match — Presidents' Day File Folder Matching Activity (Autism Educators)

overview.description: A 5-page file folder matching game: Match US presidents to their bills ($1 Washington, $5 Lincoln, $10 Hamilton, $20 Jackson, $50 Grant, $100 Franklin). One page glued to the left side of a file folder (president portrait cards), one page glued to the right (bill images with Velcro dots). Child matches portrait cards to the correct bills. From AutismEducators.com — designed specifically for children on the autism spectrum. Includes IEP goal bank reference.
gameComponents: Left folder page: president portrait cards (cut-out)
Right folder page: bill images with matching circles (Velcro attachment points)

fileFolderGameFormat.description: A file folder game is a self-contained activity station: one page glued to each inside face of a manila folder. The child opens the folder and works the activity. Portable, storable, reusable. Uses Velcro or pockets for physical matching. The file folder IS the game board.
fileFolderGameFormat.value: Tactile, self-contained, portable. No loose pieces (everything lives in the folder). Great for busy bags, car trips, waiting rooms. The physical matching (Velcro) adds kinesthetic engagement.

autismAdaptedDesign.description: From AutismEducators.com — designed for children on the autism spectrum. Clean visual layout, minimal distractions, clear matching task, physical manipulation (Velcro), predictable structure. The publisher offers IEP Goal Banks — these activities are aligned to Individualized Education Program goals.
autismAdaptedDesign.value: Materials designed for neurodivergent learners often work better for ALL learners. Clean layout, clear task, physical engagement = universal good design.

realWorldImages.description: Uses actual US bill images — real money, not cartoon versions. Same 'respect the child's intelligence with real images' principle as the Montessori nomenclature cards.
realWorldImages.value: Financial literacy with accurate representations. The child recognizes actual bills, not simplified drawings.

gaps.name: file-folder-game
gaps.description: A two-page printable designed to be glued inside a manila file folder. Left page: moveable pieces (cards, labels) with Velcro backing. Right page: matching targets with Velcro dots. Self-contained, portable, reusable. Generatable for any matching skill: money identification, vocabulary matching, color sorting, shape matching, Spanish vocabulary.

notes: Another autism-specific resource from Aless — reinforces her inclusivity signal from the Kennedy Center drop. The file folder game is a new activity FORMAT for Homa. It's different from worksheets (reusable), flash cards (two-sided flat), and clip cards (single cards). The file folder is a portable game station. Also: this is a math/social studies crossover (money + presidents) — consistent with Aless's cross-curricular pattern.
